mapper.select: SELECT t_help_doc.*, t_help_doc_catalog.name as helpDocCatalogName FROM t_help_doc left join t_help_doc_catalog on t_help_doc_catalog.help_doc_catalog_id = t_help_doc.help_doc_catalog_id

SELECT t_help_doc.* , t_help_doc_catalog.name as helpDocCatalogName FROM t_help_doc left join t_help_doc_catalog on t_help_doc_catalog.help_doc_catalog_id = t_help_doc.help_doc_catalog_id
AND t_help_doc.help_doc_catalog_id = #{query.helpDocCatalogId}
AND ( t_help_doc.title LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{query.keywords}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' OR t_help_doc.author LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{query.keywords}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%' )
AND t_help_doc.create_time >= CAST(#{query.createTimeBegin} AS date)
AND t_help_doc.create_time < CAST(#{query.createTimeEnd} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day'
ORDER BY t_help_doc.sort ASC, t_help_doc.create_time DESC
